name: longbridge
description: Connect Longbridge to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Longbridge MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Longbridge to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with brokerage and market data using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Longbridge workspace.
Find anything in Longbridge that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review brokerage and market data in Longbridge.
